selection_reason: Modern, complete round-robin league listed in the current open-data catalog and unused by this project; chosen for coverage before qualifying outcomes are calculated.
pattern_A: Existing frozen original environment-first 2+ shots rule.
pattern_B: Pattern A plus previous-five-start average shots >=3 and average minutes >=80.
decision_policy: No threshold changes, exclusions based on results, or dataset substitution after outcomes. Preserve every sample, exclusion and unknown.
limits: Women's football is a different population; this tests portability of the mechanism and is not direct validation of a men's MLS betting rate.
Historical lineup-time starters are treated as known; publication timing is not reconstructed.
